description: The European Commission Joint Research Centre research team and contributors publish an open European hydropower inventory for power-system modelling. The current README lists 4,264 plants with identifiers, names, capacities, coordinates and plant types. Additional fields include pumping capacity, nominal head, usable reservoir size, storage capacity and annual expected generation where available. It links plants to GEO, PyPSA-EUR and the Global Power Plant Database, represented here by data-global-power-plant-database. CSV tables and JSON data-package documentation are available through GitHub, free under CC BY 4.0. The inventory can define hydro assets for model-pypsa and related capacity-planning studies. A caveat is that storage capacity is recorded only when directly reported, so missing values must not be interpreted as zero. Source dates and attribute completeness vary. The authors explicitly describe this as an open project, not an official Commission product. No plant table was downloaded.
